critical_code_review_comments: services/receipt_pdf_pro.py:424-450 — Brand watermark lockup is correctly guarded by `if gap_h >= 48` so a shrinking gap (extra trust rows, translated strings) will safely skip the block instead of overlapping. Good defensive sizing.

The setFillColor→setFillAlpha ordering fix (lines 442-443 for INK, 446-447 for SLATE) is the RCA — ReportLab's setFillColor(HexColor) resets the fill alpha to 1.0, so any subsequent setFillAlpha(0.13) must come AFTER the setFillColor. Verified via pixel sampling: darkest channel in the watermark rect is 224 (light gray) — not the full-ink RGB(14,21,41) INK color. Consider extracting a helper `_set_semi_transparent_fill(pdf, color, alpha)` to prevent this class of bug from re-appearing in future PDF edits.
Watermark uses `pdf.saveState()` / `pdf.restoreState()` correctly so the alpha state does not leak into the subsequent footer bar drawing.

The invoice PDF variant is covered (test_brand_watermark_on_invoice) but only the 'INV-' doc-number path is asserted for count>=4; a small future enhancement would be to also assert the watermark is skipped when the extreme-vertical-content scenario shrinks gap<48pt (currently uncovered branch).

Bottom footer bar text at pdf-y ≈10-20pt ('Auto-generated by RealAICoach • RCT-... • v1.2.0') is NOT considered an overlap with the watermark — it is the intended footer content. Test file documents this explicitly.

rca of the issue: Root cause of the previously-empty gap: services/receipt_pdf_pro.py drew the QR trust panel and then immediately jumped to the footer bar with no content in between, leaving ~140pt of blank vertical space on the letter page. Fix (main agent): inserted a centered brand-lockup block after the trust panel that dynamically sizes to gap_h = ry-10 - 38, draws (a) the logo tile at setFillAlpha(0.15), (b) 'RealAICoach' bold text at setFillAlpha(0.13), (c) subtitle '{TITLE} • {doc_num}' at setFillAlpha(0.24). Sub-RCA: initial implementation drew text at full ink because ReportLab's `setFillColor(HexColor)` resets fill alpha to 1.0; the correct order is setFillColor THEN setFillAlpha (fixed at lines 442-443 and 446-447). Verified via pixel sampling — darkest RGB channel in the watermark rect is 224, not 14 (which would be the full INK color).
